# DigiDog

> DigiDog connects Claude and AI agents to the tools a business already uses: CRM, bookings, email, analytics and websites. Founded and run by Erik Budanov. Agents can run on Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or a local model. Code, accounts and API keys are created in the client's name.

DigiDog (digidog.org) is an AI integration company, not the "Digidog" police robot. Contact: hey@digidog.org. Languages: English and German. Real client cases in Europe, the UK and the US.

## Services
- [AI Integration and AI Agents](https://digidog.org/services/ai-integration): a free 45-minute process walk-through, then an AI agent pilot (usually 2-3 weeks), then monthly run and improve.
- [KI-Integration (Deutsch)](https://digidog.org/de/dienstleistungen/ki-integration): German version for Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

## Case studies
- Be Original Tours (tour operator): one Claude chat reads Google Ads, GA4 and tour data. It found EUR 18,099 of duplicate ad spend and pulled 6,850 reviews from 12 cities onto the website.
- Lead agent: reads a prospect's website, compares it with their top-10 Google competitors and drafts a personal first email.
- One chat for many WordPress sites: an MCP gateway connects Claude to client WordPress sites for redirects, translations and content updates.
- [Portfolio](https://digidog.org/portfolio): all client cases.

## About
- [Erik Budanov](https://digidog.org/about): MSc Engineering, TU Wien; previously SMA Solar Technology and Siemens. Top Rated Plus on Upwork, 100% Job Success, 54 jobs, 7,830 hours.
